text:
deploy-bot: Kicking off release `release/2026-03-22-4` in ~10m. Plan: feature `@new_rewrite` 0% -> 5% now, stepwise to 20% over 35m. Primary model: `rewrite-llm-3a` pinned for rollout. Watch: p95 latency, 5xx rate, and downstream cache errors. Auto-dry-run rollback if 5xx >1.5% or p95 delta >250ms. Release doc: https://go/release/2026-03-22-4

rachel: FYI we've got an intermittent 403 from EU edge this morning. I'd prefer staging EU at 0% until infra confirms edge fix.

marco: +1 to holding EU. Setting a region gate: `--regions=global,-eu` for initial flip. Ops will run smoke in eu-edge before unblocking.

tia: preflight green. Canary (us-east-1) at 5% last 12m: 5xx 0.1%, p95 baseline unchanged. I can execute cohort drain if needed: `/deploy flag update new_rewrite 0 --reason="drain"`

nate: SRE thresholds applied: `5xx_block=0.015, p95_block_ms=250`. Pager to #eng-oncall + oncall rotation. Added a quick fallback to `rewrite-llm-3b` (lighter quant) via `/infra model fallback rewrite-llm-3b --scope=new_rewrite`

analytics-bot: note -> we will tag this rollout with `eu-held` if EU remains blocked. Surface conversion and latency cohorts at 5/10/20%. Link to metric dashboard: https://go/analytics/dash/6854330000

devops-bot: preflight: infra-check ok, quota ok, certs valid. Canary logs: https://go/logs/6854330000-canary

deploy-bot: Flipping 5% to non-EU now. Expect updates at 5m intervals. Window 01:05 -> 01:40 UTC.

rachel: confirmed, EU excluded from the flag. pls add `eu-held` tag to release notes.

marco: running EU smoke tests (CORS + auth) now, ETA 6m. If green, will remove hold.

tia: ramp monitor set: small-batch sampling for human review at 10%. If conversion metric drops by >2 percentage points we pause.

nate: also enabling soft-fallback: route 25% of flagged traffic to read-path on failure detection while keeping majority on normal path. That should reduce user impact.

deploy-bot: 5% applied (ts 6854330300). Observed: 5xx 0.12%, p95 +9ms. No blocks. Next: 10% in 8m.

rachel: noting 403 traces in EU still, do not unhold. Marco, hold on the unblock until we see <0.5% 4xx in EU smoke.

marco: ack. rerunning a focused replay for EU: `/infra replay --target=eu-edge --trace=6854329000`

analytics-bot: watching conversion A/B. Alert rule: `conversion_drop_pp>2` will pause the ramp. Team leads notified.

tia: 8m check: ramp to 10% now (ts 6854330600) but still excluding EU. Baselines steady.

nate: adding an audit line: `audit/6854330000-rollout.log` and snapshotting model pin metadata. Fallback ready.

deploy-bot: 20% target achieved early (ts 6854330820). Current: 5xx 0.3%, p95 +22ms, conversion delta -0.4pp. No auto-rollback. EU remains at 0% hold. Marking rollout status: partial (EU-held). Please file any manual ops under the release ticket and add notes if you exercised fallback. :white_check_mark:
